stemMd: Which inequality holds for every real x?
explanationMd: Every real square is nonnegative. Adding 2 makes it strictly positive for all x, including zero. The alternatives each fail for simple allowed values.

distractorRationale.d: A negative square is never positive.
distractorRationale.c: This fails when the absolute value of x is below 1.
